## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use the right arm to press down on the blue stapler for holding papers.

Task description: The object is the blue stapler slightly right of center on the table. Press it downward with the right arm.

Success criteria: The right gripper must press the blue stapler and make actual contact near the specified press point, close horizontally and in height. Hovering above it is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Consider choosing a contact point inside the flat surface of the blue lid, away from the edge, hinge, and metal gaps, reducing the risk of the fingertip slipping or getting caught.
- Close the right gripper somewhat so the solid fingertip contact surfaces cover the press area, avoiding the stapler sitting between the fingers without actual contact even when the end effector reaches its target.
- Near the contact point, press down slowly along the table normal, using small movements to observe contact. This reduces sideways slipping from an angled push and avoids a large continued descent after contact.
